sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.2: Cron expression · default: 30 */2 * * * * (at second 30 every 2 minutes, avoiding the start of each minute).
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.4: Used unless a module-specific override is set below.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.5: Follow global uses core.logging.level. Saving immediately updates the corresponding pino loggers; no restart is needed.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.8: Applies to both post polling and livestream logs for this source (dynamic and live share this level).
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.12: Checks source login status every N minutes. An expired login creates an issue and sends a private notification.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.14: Text in push history is kept indefinitely. Images and original resend data older than this many days are deleted; those entries can no longer be resent.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.16: Writes a [mem] log every 10 minutes (heap usage / limit / RSS / chat volume) to help trace leaks. The overview resource card does not depend on it. Warnings near the heap limit remain enabled.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.19: When disabled, only y/n approvals remain available so pending weekly reports can still be approved.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.21: May be empty. With no prefix, unrecognized messages are ignored to avoid replying to ordinary conversation.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.23: Replies with a card or text when anyone posts a link supported by an enabled source parser in a group. The default and per-group overrides control which groups respond and how. OneBot works directly. For QQ official bots, enable reception of all group messages in group settings, or mention the bot when posting the link.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.25: How long to wait before generating another image for the same video in the same group; 0 disables the cooldown. Fixed limits also apply: {value1} images per group per minute and {value2} concurrent jobs globally, to prevent flooding with different videos.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.27: Default parsing and reply format for every group the bot is in: image card, mini-app card, or text. Groups without overrides follow this row. Mini-app cards require get_mini_app_ark support in the target’s OneBot implementation (currently known to work with NapCat); otherwise they fall back to image cards.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.29: Reply with an image card, mini-app card, or text in groups without overrides.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.31: Groups come from configured push targets. Follow default leaves a setting unchanged. To parse only in selected groups, disable parsing by default and explicitly enable those groups. Disabled targets do not parse; re-enabling restores parsing. Deleted targets disappear from this list.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.33: The primary command name always works. Conflicting aliases are rejected when saving.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.35: Select the provider instance used by default. Switching retains each instance’s keys and model configuration.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.37: Converts thinking parameters for the selected provider. Custom sends no provider-specific parameters; add any required values to extra request parameters.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.39: Distinguishes multiple instances of the same provider. Leave empty to display the provider name.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.41: Chat Completions is the existing format. Responses is the newer OpenAI-family protocol, with standard thinking fields and more reliable thinking with tools. This option is shown only for providers with confirmed support. Failures do not silently fall back to the old protocol.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.43: Choose the web search service. Bocha focuses on Chinese content; Tavily offers a free quota.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.45: Get a key at open.bochaai.com. Leave empty to disable this search service.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.46: Get a key at app.tavily.com. Leave empty to disable this search service.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.48: The instances listed on the left. Deleting an instance also deletes its stored keys.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.49: Lets the model think before answering, which may increase latency and cost. If the gateway does not support it, thinking parameters are removed and the request is retried once.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.51: Maps to the provider’s thinking effort or token budget. The selected level is retained when switching providers.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.53: Enter a JSON object of extra request parameters. These values override parameters with the same name; invalid JSON is ignored. Structural fields model / messages / tools cannot be overridden.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.55: Enable if the main model can read images (such as gpt-4o or qwen-vl). Images go directly to it, avoiding an extra round trip and loss of detail. Otherwise configure the vision model below. A configured vision model always takes priority and makes this switch ineffective.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.57: Set this when the main model cannot read images (for example, DeepSeek). The vision model describes the image as text for the main model. It takes priority over the switch above. Leave empty to disable.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.59: Leave empty to use the main model’s URL. Only needed when the vision model uses another provider.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.61: Leave empty to use the main model’s key.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.65: A sentence or question · up to 500 characters.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.67: Choose a saved personality for this subscription from AI maid. Edit or create personalities there.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.69: Choose the default personality. Switching does not modify the contents of any personality.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.74: Apply a preset to quickly fill in the personality and prompts.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.75: Leave empty to follow the preset.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.82: The opening of the system prompt, defining the AI’s identity.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.84: Appended to the system prompt for safety constraints, words to avoid, and tone adjustments.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.86: Choose a card skin for this subscription; leave empty to follow the global setting. To customize its layout, first duplicate a skin in the skin library and edit the copy.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.88: Select a subscription to use real preview data when its source supports it. With none selected, sample data is used.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.94: Determines the background color and duration (30/50/100/500/1000).
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.96: Determines the badge image and background color.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.99: Regular expressions. Matching posts are blocked.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.101: When not empty, only matching posts are pushed.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.108: Amounts below this are not pushed · 0 includes all amounts.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.110: Push membership events for the selected tier and higher tiers.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.112: After a stream starts, repeat the live status notification at the interval below. This global default can be overridden per subscription.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.115: If a subscription is live when the service restarts, send one notification immediately.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.117: Delay confirming that a stream ended. If it restarts during the wait, treat it as the same session.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.120: Pushes within these hours are withheld and recorded in push history for manual resend. Uses whole hours and the half-open interval [start, end).
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.124: Separates adjacent text blocks in the same message; \n means a line break.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.133: When disabled, use the source’s default membership content.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.138: For gallery posts, send a group of images after the text. When disabled, send only the card.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.label.139: Merge image galleries into forwarded messages
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.140: Enabled: a chat-history card. Disabled: regular messages with multiple images. Single images are never merged into forwarded messages.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.188: Records how a default text update notice was handled so it is not shown again.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.143: Only enabled external delivery targets are listed.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.147: The bot connects to this port. The port identifies the connection and is independent of the main port, 8787.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.150: Image messages wait for max(timeout, this value). 0 leaves the timeout unchanged.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.152: Merged forwards download and upload each image, so they take longer than a single image. 0 leaves the timeout unchanged.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.154: Attempts after a failure, excluding the initial attempt.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.157: For example, reverse proxy authentication headers.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.159: QQ Open Platform bot AppID (stored as plain text).
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.160: Bot secret, used to obtain an App Access Token.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.162: Private-domain bots support native Markdown (merged image galleries). Public-domain bots require registered templates instead of native Markdown.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.164: Uses the QQ sandbox environment, visible only to sandbox members.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.166: The QQ official gateway normally requests a reconnect about every 30 minutes. Disabled by default to reduce log noise; enable for troubleshooting.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.171: Generate and send automatically on schedule. When disabled, reports can only be generated manually.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.173: A preview is sent privately. Reply y to send it to groups; it expires after 48 hours without a reply.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.175: Send a private explanation if generation fails, no target is configured, or a group delivery fails.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.179: Days included in each report (last 7 / 30 / 90 days), independent of the send schedule. For example, send a ranking for the last 7 days every day.
sourceUi.config.field.labels.hint.181: Multiple selections allowed. A failed group delivery does not affect other groups.
